findings.finding: The revised installer invokes `NoRedirect()` when building its opener, but the reviewed file neither imports nor defines `NoRedirect`. Execution raises NameError before the artifact download.
findings.recommendation: Define a local HTTPRedirectHandler whose redirect_request returns None, or import a separately pinned helper present in the execution environment; then recheck exact file hash.

closed_r1_findings.redirect_ssrf: CLOSED_SOURCE: opener disables environment proxy and NoRedirect is intended; initial URL requires HTTPS, approved hostname suffix and port 443. Installer execution remains blocked by the missing NoRedirect symbol.
closed_r1_findings.acl_helper_path_and_integrity: CLOSED_SOURCE: prepare-core pins SHA-256 e63b20... and copies the ACL helper into the exact path referenced by ExecStartPre.

source_boundary.inactive_platform: Installer verifies exact CI zip/tar/manifest, extracts into a new release, hashes every file/link, creates platform-only locked no-compile venv, runs pip check, and compares pointer snapshots. No unit activation or pointer switch is present.
source_boundary.inactive_core: prepare-core checks the 69 original source hashes, exact patched HTTP hash, shared/runtime package hashes, and pinned ACL helper hash; copies into a new versioned directory; records a manifest and reports active_core_unchanged. It does not switch the active runtime.
source_boundary.integrated_checks: check-integrated-core discovers the expected 1,035 tests and monkeypatches Python TCP/DNS. Its use is safe only inside the promised OS PrivateNetwork isolation, since Python monkeypatches alone do not block subprocess or raw UDP network attempts.
source_boundary.native_unit: Dedicated Group and UID, bounded memory/tasks/shutdown, private filesystem, old credential paths inaccessible, no credentials in environment, separate socket, starts with the product dependency.

budget.assessment: Tight pass by source math only; fresh disk/inode/memory recheck is mandatory before each copy stage.
